title: Flint n' Tools
description: A mod adding flint tools for use in realistic progression packs.
body:
A mod adding items and game mechanics for realistic early-game progression.

This mod is not intended for use on its own; it is intended for use in modpacks that are based on realistic progression/gameplay.

You may use this mod in your modpack as long as you provide a clickable link to it in the description.

## Discord
If you want to see sneak-peeks or interact with a growing community, join my Discord! Also report any bugs you find there.
